user_choice: More contracts held simultaneously because dollar net profit per trade is small.
interpretation: A fixed whole-contract quantity per session, chosen before trading; all contracts share one entry, stop, target and deadline exit.
validation: Positive whole-number integer, not boolean or fractional.
unchanged_rules: Same point targets, stops and context policies
cost_semantics: Existing round_trip_cost_dollars remains PER CONTRACT. Position round-trip cost = contracts times this per-contract assumption. Default $2.24 per contract.
accounting: gross_points remains unscaled per-contract price movement; contract_points = gross_points * contracts; gross, net and cost dollar amounts scale with quantity.
size_policy: Fixed for the whole replay; no profit/loss-dependent increase, averaging down or partial exits are implemented.
strategy_selection: Sizing is arithmetic sensitivity, not additional optimized signal variants or evidence that expectancy becomes positive.
execution_limit: Assumes identical price-event fills across quantities; depth, market impact, partial fills and quantity-dependent slippage are not modeled.
